[EN] The weapon at the center of Bathysmal Rise is...impressive, to say the least. I have only seen it once, for only a moment, before I was forced to flee.

I am looking forward to seeing it again...when it is safe.
[ES] El arma en el centro de Bathysmal Rise es... impresionante, por decirlo suavemente. Solo la he visto una vez, por un breve momento, antes de que me vieran obligado a huir.

Tengo muchas ganas de volver a verla... cuando sea seguro.
